chars.NARRATOR: a shy young Moroccan man in his mid-twenties, short black curly hair, light stubble, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie, dark blue jeans and white sneakers
chars.GIRL: a pretty young Moroccan woman in her early twenties, long wavy brown hair tied in a low ponytail, wearing a sage-green blazer over a cream top, black trousers, a small brown shoulder bag

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Busy Moroccan city street in Casablanca at late afternoon, the GIRL steps out of the glass door of a small shop where she works; across the sidewalk the NARRATOR freezes mid-step and stares at her wide-eyed, surprised. Both in the centre of the frame.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: On the sidewalk the NARRATOR walks up to the GIRL and waves awkwardly with a nervous smile; she turns and smiles warmly, recognizing him. Moroccan street with shops and palm trees in soft background.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: The NARRATOR, rubbing the back of his neck, gestures politely down the street offering to walk her; the GIRL holds her shoulder bag strap and hesitates with a shy smile. Moroccan city street, warm light.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Wide shot from behind at medium distance: the NARRATOR and the GIRL walk side by side down a Moroccan boulevard with whitewashed buildings at golden hour, keeping a respectful gap, both slightly turned toward each other chatting.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: The NARRATOR stops walking and nervously asks the GIRL something, hands fidgeting; the GIRL raises her eyebrows in surprise, a hand on her chest. Moroccan street corner, evening light.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Comic moment: the NARRATOR is sweating, eyes squeezed, struggling to get his words out, tiny sweat drops flying; the GIRL watches him with an amused, patient smile. Moroccan street, warm sunset.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: The GIRL nods yes with a sweet smile; the NARRATOR beams with joy, almost jumping, fist clenched in a small victory gesture. Moroccan street at sunset.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: The NARRATOR alone in his small bedroom in a Moroccan apartment, pacing nervously, hands on his head, worried expression, evening light through the window with a traditional patterned curtain.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: The NARRATOR stands in front of a bathroom mirror in a Moroccan apartment practising talking, mouth tense, anxious face, nervous gestures, his reflection visible in the mirror.
